item: the Windows proactor loop's connects and datagrams meet the airplane rule; netlink and numeric getnameinfo pass
summary: R643: on Windows the stdlib proactor loop (loop=asyncio there) connects through _overlapped.ConnectEx/WSAConnect and sends datagrams through WSASendTo, past socket.connect/sendto, and an IP-literal target skips getaddrinfo, so an asyncio connect or datagram to a literal met no guard in airplane mode. IocpProactor.connect and IocpProactor.sendto are now patch points with the connect and datagram rules (alias refused, localhost swapped, non-loopback refused, SSRF check on connect); the proactor is kept. R645 (S1's follow-ups): AF_NETLINK is exempt like AF_UNIX on every patched call (connect, connect_ex, bind, sendto, sendmsg, the proactor pair) (AF_PACKET stays refused), and getnameinfo with NI_NUMERICHOST|NI_NUMERICSERV on any literal passes, since it makes no lookup; the private _socket bypass was already listed in SECURITY.md by R641. Release line: on Windows, airplane mode now also stops connections and single datagrams sent from the app's own event loop to a raw IP address.
